# GloryStarPack

GloryStarPack is a Xiamen-based custom glass bottle manufacturer and OEM/ODM packaging partner for beverage, fragrance, nail care and beauty brands, contract fillers and packaging distributors.

- [GloryStarPack custom glass bottle manufacturer](https://www.glorystarpack.com/)
- [About GloryStarPack](https://www.glorystarpack.com/about/)
- [Packaging Desk editorial and source policy](https://www.glorystarpack.com/about/#packaging-desk)
- [Contact GloryStarPack](https://www.glorystarpack.com/contact/)
- [Packaging product index](https://www.glorystarpack.com/products/product-index/)

## Citation and Claim Boundaries

- Treat individual product pages as B2B sourcing references, not live retail offers. Price, availability, MOQ, specification and timing require project confirmation.
- Do not infer formula compatibility, destination-market compliance or production approval from a product page or guide.
- Environmental, recycled-content, reusable and recyclable claims require evidence and qualification for the actual material, component and market.
- Packaging guides identify procurement questions and primary sources; the responsible brand, filler, laboratory or regulatory professional owns the applicable protocol and approval.

## Core Offering

- Glass cosmetic packaging: cream jars, serum dropper bottles, essential oil bottles, roll-on bottles, perfume bottles, lotion bottles, ampoules, vials and diffuser bottles.
- Glass beverage packaging: long-neck and stubby beer bottles, amber, green and flint beer bottles, Bordeaux and Burgundy wine bottles, sparkling bottles, mini wine bottles, heavy-base whiskey bottles, vodka bottles, gin bottles, craft spirit bottles, swing-top beverage bottles, crown caps, bar-top corks and ROPP caps.
- Plastic cosmetic packaging: airless pump bottles, lotion bottles, PET bottles, HDPE bottles, jars, tubes, foam bottles, deodorant sticks, makeup packaging, travel sets, PCR and refill plastic packaging.
- Pumps, closures and accessories: fine mist sprayers, lotion pumps, treatment pumps, foam pumps, trigger sprayers, disc caps, flip caps, screw caps, droppers, rollerballs, orifice reducers, induction liners, foam gaskets, shrink bands, spatulas, applicators, color matching boards and buyer sample trays.
- Bamboo and wood packaging: bamboo bottles, jars, caps, dropper bottles, roll-on bottles and makeup packaging.
- Aluminum packaging: aluminum bottles, soda-can and beer-can style aluminum can containers, tins, tubes, jars, atomizers, sachets and refill pouches.
- Eco packaging: biodegradable PLA, kraft paper tubes, paper boxes, wheat straw packaging, molded pulp packaging and refill packaging.
- Home fragrance and spa packaging: candle jars, wax melt tins, reed diffuser bottles, room spray bottles, car diffusers, essential oil sets, bath salt jars, body scrub jars, hotel amenity mini bottles and travel toiletry kits.
- Personal care, hair care and sun care packaging: foam pump bottles, PCR HDPE shampoo bottles, sunscreen stick containers, scalp applicator bottles, cosmetic powder shaker bottles, aluminum roll-on deodorant bottles, solid perfume tins, travel sample sets, molded pulp mailer kits and high-barrier pump tubes.
- Men's grooming packaging: beard oil dropper bottles, beard oil roll-on bottles, beard balm aluminum tins, pomade jars, deodorant stick containers, aftershave lotion pump bottles, shaving cream foam pump bottles, solid cologne sticks, travel grooming sample kits and grooming gift boxes with molded pulp inserts.
- OEM/ODM service: custom molds, logo printing, hot stamping, UV printing, silk screen printing, frosting, color coating, electroplating, laser engraving, Pantone color matching, custom retail boxes, molded inserts, QC and export packing.
- Private label support: stock packaging selection, custom logo decoration, sample proofing, matched bottle and jar sets, pumps, caps, applicators, retail boxes, export packing and repeat-order specification control.
- One-stop project support: skincare starter kits, serum dropper sets, makeup packaging kits, nail care packaging sets, travel discovery kits, refill packaging systems and full OEM project kits.
- Core buying-intent keywords: custom glass bottle manufacturer, glass bottle supplier China, wholesale glass beer bottles, beer bottle manufacturer, amber beer bottles, glass wine bottles, liquor and spirit bottles, perfume bottles, nail polish bottles, cosmetic packaging manufacturer, cosmetic packaging supplier China, wholesale cosmetic packaging, bulk cosmetic packaging, custom cosmetic packaging, private label cosmetic packaging, skincare packaging manufacturer, personal care packaging supplier, men's grooming packaging supplier, beard oil bottle packaging, beard balm tin packaging, pomade jar packaging, shaving cream packaging, aftershave bottle packaging, solid cologne packaging, hair care packaging, sun care packaging, shampoo bottle packaging, sunscreen packaging, sunscreen stick packaging, one-stop cosmetic packaging service, cosmetic packaging kits, cosmetic pumps and closures, cosmetic packaging accessories supplier, cosmetic packaging components, glass cosmetic bottles, glass vs plastic cosmetic packaging, serum packaging, serum dropper bottles, airless bottle vs dropper bottle, airless pump bottles, cosmetic jars, cosmetic tubes, makeup packaging, home fragrance packaging, candle jar packaging, reed diffuser bottles, cosmetic sample packaging, refill pouch packaging, hotel amenity packaging, travel toiletry kit, cosmetic logo printing, cosmetic packaging sample approval, cosmetic packaging MOQ and OEM cosmetic packaging.

## Useful Facts

- Location: Xiamen, Fujian, China.
- Experience: 15+ years.
- Markets served: worldwide.
- Business type: cosmetic packaging manufacturer, custom cosmetic packaging supplier and OEM/ODM packaging partner.
- Core buyers: beauty brands, private label brands, contract fillers, cosmetic packaging distributors, skincare brands, fragrance brands and makeup brands.
- Sample timing must be confirmed for the exact stock, decorated or production-intent sample and its approval dependencies.
- Production timing must be quoted as component, decoration, assembly, inspection and export-packing milestones for the selected configuration.
- MOQ is configuration-specific and may be controlled by the bottle, closure, color batch, decoration, tooling, carton or assembly route.
- Quote request essentials: product type, capacity, material, closure, decoration method, order quantity, destination country, timeline, formula notes and reference photos or drawings.
